description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Summary' that displays summarized temperature and day count data retrieved from AsyncStorage. It includes functions for data processing, refresh handling, and rendering a list of items.

methods.name: getScreenData
methods.description: Processes raw data to generate display information for different data types ('record', 'hottest', 'coldest').

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from AsyncStorage, processes it to find temperature extremes and total days, and updates the component state.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders an individual item in the FlatList using the Item component.
